commits.subject: fix(agent): add nvm support for auto-update on Linux VMs
commits.body:
The auto-updater was failing on Linux VMs using nvm because npm wasn't
in the PATH. This fix:
- Sources nvm in the update script before running npm install
- Passes NVM_DIR and NVM_BIN environment variables to the spawned process
- Adds tests for nvm support
